title: pandanus lucidus
intro: Pandanus lucidus, commonly known as the Chinese screwpine or Chinese pandan, is a plant species native to China and Southeast Asia. It is a type of evergreen shrub or small tree that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The health benefits of Pandanus lucidus are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
